segment: Adjacent: charitable gift administration (gift annuities, charitable remainder trusts, pooled income funds) at charities, community foundations and universities
can_sponsor_daf: yes (issuer is normally a 501(c)(3) public charity)
why_not_offering_today: Not a DAF question: these organizations already run planned giving; the adjacency is selling them a second module (most outsource administration to PG Calc/Foundation Source or bank trust departments)
count_basis: No public count of CGA issuers located; ACGA survey not fetched (P3-GAP-FGJ005)

segment: Adjacent: comprehensive fiscal sponsors (Model A project hosts)
why_not_offering_today: Capacity and scale: most are small; DAF sponsorship is a separate programme with its own policies; no evidence of demand
count_basis: 2023 field scan mailing list; Fiscal Sponsor Directory

segment: Adjacent: grant and scholarship administration at community foundations and private/corporate foundations
can_sponsor_daf: partly (community foundations yes; private foundations no)
why_not_offering_today: Already served by grants suites (Foundant/SmartSimple/GivingData; Blackbaud); a DAF vendor adds no reason to switch
organizations_count_estimate: >3,350 organizations on the Foundant group platforms (vendor claim)

segment: Adjacent: endowment and restricted-fund pool accounting (university, hospital and community foundation unitized pools)
can_sponsor_daf: yes (institutionally related foundations are public charities)
why_not_offering_today: Endowment accounting sits in ERP/fund accounting and custodian systems; DAF is a donor product, not an accounting need
organizations_count_estimate: 657 NACUBO study participants ($944.3B); hospital foundations not counted

segment: Adjacent: employee giving and corporate philanthropy platforms
why_not_offering_today: They route donations through their own or partner charitable entities; buyers of vetting and disbursement services rather than of DAF administration
organizations_count_estimate: A handful of large platforms (Benevity, Bonterra, Blackbaud, Deed etc.)

why_not_offering_today: Different tax regime (excise tax, payout, self-dealing); dominated by Foundation Source and family-office/bank administration
organizations_count_estimate: not computed (derive from IRS BMF foundation codes)

segment: Adjacent: bank and trust-company trust administration
why_not_offering_today: Fiduciary regulation and entrenched trust-accounting cores (FIS, SEI, SS&C)

segment: Adjacent: escrow and 1031 qualified intermediaries; other custodial accounting (UTMA, client trust accounts)
why_not_offering_today: Not charitable; state bonding/licensing; different buyers

segment: Adjacent: community investment and impact-investing programmes at foundations (loan funds, impact notes)
can_sponsor_daf: yes (when run by a public charity)
why_not_offering_today: Loan servicing and securities law dominate; little ledger overlap beyond restricted balances
count_basis: Screening judgment; no public count fetched
